notes.title: Early Access V0.4.0.0 - Major Language Update + Time to Drop the Prologue
notes.notes:
Hello Solaroids players around the world - literally.  It was high time that the supported languages get an overhaul after adding so much TEXT to the game.  So, with this release I'm happy to announce that all major supported languages will be complete once again - now or very soon. They are actively being worked on by localization experts around the world so expect a few small patches to complete to the work over the coming weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28234657/f9c736718bcc80b114966a16a2316edd5f085b79.gif[/img]

Oh and another thing... It's also time to drop the Prologue from the title and branding.  I conceived of the Prologue sub-text as my way of introducing an incomplete game to the Steam Early Access community.  While I still plan more updates before leaving Early Access, the game has grown out of its Prologue moniker.  In addition, I've noticed a lot of demos being branded as Prologues over 2020, and Solaroids: Prologue is [b]not[/b] a demo! Hopefully, this reconciles that annoyance as well. I still have to make a new trailer and update screenshots, but if you see any references to Prologue lurking about, let me know!

Those are the big things this round, but on a smaller scale I've tweaked the default options to something that I think will improve the first player experience.  If you want to "trust me" and try them for yourself, just go to the Miscellaneous menu and hit that Reset button ːsteamsaltyː.

Enjoy!

Chad (Kiates)

[*]Add back button to difficulty selection screen.
[*]Optimization to the vector renderer.
[*]High score listing now shows up after 5 seconds instead of 10.
[*]Allow rebinding of [b]ENTER[/b] and [b]ESC[/b] keys for use in-game.
[*]Language option is sorted by popularity now.
[*]Switch from Solaroids: Prologue branding to Solaroids.
[*]Change default zoom level from 100% to 130%.
[*]Change default inertial dampening from 20% to 50%.
[*]Change default HUD size from 100% to 125%.
[*]Change default reticle size from 100% to 150%.
[*]Change default controller vibration to 50%.
[*]Change default music volume from 60% to 40%.
[*]Change default vector focus from 100% to 80%.
[*]Updates to FNA/SDL libraries under the hood.
[*]Language updates:
[list]
[*]German - now current!
[*]Spanish - now current!
[*]French - now current!
[*]Portuguese (Brazilian) - now current!
[*]Serbian - now current!
[*]Russian - in progress
[*]Simplified Chinese - in progress
[*]Japanese - in progress
[*]Italian - in progress
[*]Polish - in progress
[/list]
[*]New languages:
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Early Access V0.3.0.6 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Minor feature updates and/or bug fixes, but one requested visual enhancement worth calling out...

[h2]Vector Explosions[/h2]

Vector mode now adds vector styled explosions in addition to the point "particles" it previously used. Thank you community for the great idea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28234657/608a65b9b5745f99d2fcebd0c1cd0f48c39e19b4.gif[/img]
Solaroids Palette

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28234657/8d90052e39b356c4bf6cc019b221fa32b36a2b80.gif[/img]
Asteroids Palette

[h2]New Features / Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*]Refresh icon.
[*]Vector mode now has "vector" explosion effects in addition to single point explosion "particles".
[*]Removed "Exclusive" FullScreen mode (FullScreen=On, Borderless=Off).  This mode is not necessary these days and has become an uncommon mode that made it difficult to switch back and forth between screens and other windows. In addition it made it more difficult to work with some screen recording software. Now the only full-screen mode is "Borderless" FullScreen, so as such, the Borderless option has been removed. Alt-Enter also still toggles between full screen and windowed as common among games.
[*]OSX Version now uses Vulkan for graphics which improves/restores lost performance for low-powered Macs (tested with 2016 era Mac Mini).
[*]Updates to FNA used on Linux/OSX versions.
[/list]
[h2]Issues Addressed[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fix issue with invalid unicode characters in Steam leaderboard names.
[*]Fix an issue with mouse behavior in the game and menus when running at non 1920x1080 resolutions in full screen modes.
[/list]

notes.title: Monthly High Scores - January 2020 -- Plus Mini Status Update
notes.notes:
Off to a slow start in 2020 with plenty of room in the monthly leaderboards.  I may need some help recruiting new pilots in the coming months while I finish up some pending updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28234657/b20434c9e0ae3cd24b7d146502612fb8d1d14374.jpg[/img]

It's nice to see long time player [b]Flu Orid[/b] in the monthly leaderboard this time around, and taking 1st place with a semi-serious [b]34M[/b] score. [b]morg556[/b] who took 1st place last month, came in 2nd place this month with a score just shy of [b]24M[/b]. [b]Weasel[/b] managed to "scurry up" and take 3rd place with [b]16M[/b] - sorry about the play on your name, I couldn't resist.

[h1]Mini Status Update[/h1]
As I mentioned in a previous high score announcement, I'm working on several new updates.  One of those is to introduce CRT style effects as an option in the game, that I hope will bring some additional nostalgia to old school players, or even the younger crowd that can appreciate what these old games looked like in the 80s.

In the theme of High Scores here are two more shots, with two of the work-in-progress modes active.  This first one is a relatively simple CRT effect that simulates the phosphor pattern of an Aperture Grill (aka Sony Trinitron) along with scanlines. The intensity of each will be adjustable via in-game options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28234657/622661c16b8ee81f3dafb4132c1a4065672b4434.png[/img]

Click on this thumbnail to view the full HD image. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28234657/8b189ade66b957893a6788ce167ac8f8dccf711f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28234657/edcad4734ceaab08ebbc36bb9249e2264ef6a203.jpg[/img][/url]

The 2nd one is a more advanced CRT effect that still needs a lot of work, as the fonts are getting butchered at the moment.  It will be able to simulate several phosphor patterns common for CRTs along with scanlines as well.  As seen in the screenshot, it will also be able to simulate the curvature of a real CRT, which will be fully adjustable as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28234657/849af72d5ff849587d81f0e06e58f55299a312ea.png[/img]

Likewise, here's a thumbnail you can click on to view the full HD image.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28234657/a9375020a8a8b1e2ab4f682a88deb77f21521248.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28234657/fa80f9914d6191912ce7c602e3cbdcb7ddf10019.jpg[/img][/url]

Please let me know your thoughts... Whether you like where this is going, or have additional ideas.

[h1]Track me down on Discord![/h1]
Come join the ([url=https://discord.gg/HQrm3Gp][b]Solaroids Discord Server[/b][/url]), exercise some much needed bragging rights, say high to other players, share some tips, and give me your thoughts about what would make the [b]Best Asteroids Style Space Shooter[/b] on the planet.

[h1]Sign-up[/h1]
Sign up on my [url=http://www.solaroids.com/earlyaccess/][b]Early Access Page[/b][/url] to be notified at full launch across all platforms, not just Steam.

Cheers!!

Chad (kiates)

notes.title: Early Access V0.2.4.2 - Congrats on the Weekly Scores and Vector Mode Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!  Thank you to all the players that have tried out some of the recent updates and posted scores to the new Daily/Weekly/Monthly leaderboards.

It's been about a week since the update to add Daily, Weekly, and Monthly leaderboards and I see both some familiar names as well as some new ones.  What do you think so far, yeah or meh?

Here's the top scores for the week!!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28234657/fb9b8ef79c1700d36fd4fd0fc7b9378a1f70b603.png[/img]

And for the month of March (partial month)!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28234657/2b3659a488da10b26781f99bb5a37af1592aa665.png[/img]

Speaking of leaderboards. I think it would be fun to have a speed run leaderboard.  For the current [b]Campaign[/b] it would be through Level 10 possibly with intermediate ones for each level to track progress, and for [b]Free Play[/b] mode it would be through a certain number of waves possibly with intermediate ones as well. What do you think?

In other news, work continues on the experimental Vector mode.  I've converted more of the graphics and have been playing with simulating the look of a real vector display.  Here's what it looks like with the Asteroids Deluxe colors -- as available in this EA V1.2.4.2 build. This still picture doesn't really do it justice, as the flicker effect adds a nice touch of authenticity.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28234657/de324b1543091d03071e14c8b9f5b46baf723b68.png[/img]

I'm also playing around with adding color into to the mix.  Here's a early sample of what it's looking like so far.  What do you think?  I'm thinking of making options to tune the vector mode to your liking.  If I do it would probably include an adjustment for full-color vs a single color, line thickness, beam intensity, and flicker. Would you rather see these kinds of detailed options, or just a high level Monochromatic/Multi-color option where I pick the settings?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28234657/a1e1784d5c3310efd7bd7f36b3939f03ac3223a3.png[/img]

That's all I have for this update as far as the bigger changes, but there have been several other smaller tweaks, so see the patch notes below.

Come visit me in real-time on the ([url=https://discord.gg/HQrm3Gp][b]Solaroids Discord Server[/b][/url]), and give me your thoughts about what would make the [b]Best Asteroids Style Space Shooter[/b] on the planet. Also, don't forget to sign up on my [url=http://www.solaroids.com/earlyaccess/][b]Early Access Page[/b][/url] to be notified at full launch across all platforms.

Cheers and happy blasting!

Chad (kiates)

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[*]Cycling leaderboards now cross fade as a transition.
[*]Alternate main high score display layout with Daily/Weekly/Monthly tables at the top and Local scores at the bottom.
[*]Always show Daily scores first at the end of a game.
[*]Daily leaderboard will show your score for at least one day, up to two if your really early in the day.
[*]Enhance vector mode to emulate an Asteroids Deluxe style look.
[*]Tweak background transparency for Stage 1 graphics.
[*]Fix initial zoom factor.
[*]Suppress controller vibration when a player is not actively in the game.
[*]Fix potential issue when forfeiting.
[*]Restart soundtrack when entering the actual game.
[*]More updates to German translations.
[/list]

[h1]Issues Addressed[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix issue with local leaderboards not refreshing immediately when cleared.
[*]Fix issue showing daily/weekly/monthly rank.
[/list]

[h1]Known issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Borderless window option is only implemented for Windows right now.
[*]Disconnecting an external audio device being used by the game will cause a crash/freeze on Linux/OSX.

notes.title: Early Access V0.2.2 -- “Own Your Friends” Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Happy June and congratulations on the great scores!! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28234657/eee70b78db3ba07f56df9af5bdd7ad84e42f8c00.png[/img]

It is awesome to see the competition getting fierce on the leaderboards as well as players taking advantage of the new [b]Control Styles[/b] and score [b]Multiplier[/b]. That's the good news... the bad news is that 10 of the slots are being removed from the in-game list to make room for a small [b]Friends[/b] leaderboard ːsteamhappyː&ːsteamsadː.

If you enjoy Solaroids, please consider leaving a review as it is critical to the amount of exposure provided by steam and could really help spread the word.

I'm happy to release some new features focused on competition.  I've had statistics behind the scenes for some time, but I've always wanted to present them in-game.  Showing the last/best score in the HUD was one such feature, and I'm happy to report that now several other useful (and maybe some non-useful) statistics are now readily displayed while playing alone or with friends. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28234657/e92ed595d2098060dd17abae4038fe4b6d5e9a2e.gif[/img]

The current set of stats are shown once a round has been completed and before continuing (or while requesting to forfeit). For player 1 (normally tied to the steam account), It will display the recorded [b]Overall[/b] steam stats in addition to showing temporary session stats for [b]Current[/b], [b]Last[/b], and [b]Best[/b], For players 2-4 only stats for the current game session are tracked. If there are particular stats that you think should replace some of these, let me know in the comments or community hub.

In addition to stats, I've also decided to give each player their own mini high score listings to show their overall ranking.  This includes [b]Local[/b], [b]Global[/b], and [b]Friend[/b] listings.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28234657/bc79437d232892ce58761cae1baf50b3ccb27c35.gif[/img]

What's a game based on a competitive score mechanic without more ways to rank yourself? I hope you enjoy 1-UP'ing your friends, or at least knowing at a glance who's the best!

I also managed to get a couple of smaller features in based on community feedback. If you are one of the players that had wished for "classic" twin-stick style controls (aka Geometry wars / Robotron) when using the [b]Modern (dual-stick)[/b] control style, then you might enjoy the new [b]Fire on Aim[/b] option under the [b]Gameplay[/b] menu. [b]Fire on Aim[/b] augments the [b]Autofire[/b] setting to start firing just by aiming the ship.  One consequence of this though, is that it is harder to conserve your [b]Primary Weapon[/b] ammo. However, if you're careful not to fully press the thumb stick all the way, you can actually aim without firing as well.

Another set of small features relate to a recent request by a player to "simplify" the arena.  I think they were longing for an experience closer to some of the retro games long ago, without backdrop clutter competing against energy bullets etc.  As such, I've made it possible to adjust the background elements, such as the stars and nebula, to simplify, fade, or turn them off completely. Find these settings under the [b]Effects[/b] options menu.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Fire on Aim[/b] Option. When turned on automatically fires when aiming the ship while in the [b]Modern (dual-stick)[/b] control style -- similar to simple twin-stick shooters.
[*]When using the [b]Modern (dual-stick)[/b] control style, [b]Dynamic Braking[/b] will not be engaged unless you release the aiming control (i.e. right thumb stick).  This allows you to perform drifting strafe maneuvers similar to [b]Classic[/b] or [b]Hybrid[/b] control styles.
[*][b]Stars[/b] Option - Adjust the number of stars.
[*][b]Stars[/b] Opacity Option - Fades background stars.
[*][b]Background Opacity[/b] Option - Fades background elements such as nebula, galaxies, and planets.
[*]Global Friend high scores. Note this reduced the number of global high scores displayed in-game.
[*]Per player high scores and stats:
[list]
[*]Shown between sessions, and independently for each player.
[*]High scores include Local, Global, and Friend scores.
[*]Presently, the following stats are shown:
[list]
[*][b]Player Kills[/b] - The total number of times you have killed another player.
[*][b]Killed by Players[/b] - The total number of times you have been killed by other players.
[*][b]Asteroids[/b] - The total number of asteroids of any type destroyed.
[*][b]Small Asteroids[/b] - The total number of small asteroids destroyed.
[*][b]Outriders Held[/b] - The maximum number of outriders held at once.
[*][b]Primary Ammo[/b] - The maximum number of primary weapon bullets held at once.
[*][b]Secondary Ammo[/b] - The maximum number of secondary weapon shots held at once.
[*][b]Defensive Ammo[/b] - The maximum number of defensive weapon shots held at once.
[*][b]Powerups Collected[/b] - The total number of power-ups collected of any type.
[*][b]Bullet Efficiency[/b] - Percentage of bullets that hit a target vs. bullets fired.
[*][b]Missile Efficiency[/b] - Percentage of missiles that hit a target vs. missiles launched.
[*][b]Survival Efficiency[/b] - Player kills vs player deaths.
[/list]
[*]Stats include Current, Last, Best, and Overall values.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Previously Released Patches[/h1]
[list]
[*]The default control style is now Modern (dual-stick) instead of Classic.
[*]Fix issue with missile collisions.
[/list]

[h1]Known issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Borderless window option is only implemented for Windows right now.
[*]Disconnecting an external audio device being used by the game will cause a crash/freeze on Linux/OSX.
[*]Some options and more recent prompts are English only or machine translated right now. If machine translated, they are indicated with an asterisk (*).
[/list]

I hope you enjoy the new refinements and features.  Let me know in the comments what you think so far, how it should evolve, and if you have any favorite stats.

Once again... Happy blasting!!
